experiment: E2b repeated observations and sealed threshold transfer
selection: fixed office0 development and room0 evaluation before new GT or scores; no failed-scene replacement
observation_arm: longer input interval; raw original KF self branches only; no extra predictor or relaxed masks
primary_method_selection: development only: among spacing and relative with support veto, maximize global bad recall under 99% global and eligible normal retention; tie prefer spacing

normalizations.spacing: existing E2 positive front margin / local raw point spacing
normalizations.relative: existing E2 spacing-normalized margin * local spacing / observed point radius

repeat_score: second largest finite per-view front score at same decision revision; >=2 distinct raw events; no union across snapshots
support_veto: a finite reliable plane front score of zero from any source-disjoint view vetoes repeated rejection in that snapshot; unknown/occluded views neither reject nor certify support
decision: strict score > development threshold at actual KF snapshot; lock first crossing; no actual map deletion; cumulative maximum score used only to calibrate the equivalent any-crossing rule
calibration: higher quantile of development normal per-candidate cumulative maximum over all causal re-evaluations; missing kept; no eligible development normal => uncalibrated, no GO
gt_views: even original frame IDs every 20 frames plus actual original KF IDs; GT never features
evaluation_pose: creation snapshot; evaluation-only global Sim3 fitted on mapping trajectory camera centers; GT-anchor sensitivity retains predicted scale
scope: one development scene and one different evaluation scene; diagnostic would_reject only; E3 decision readiness, not map efficacy or statistical independence
evaluation_rule: seal rules and selected development method/thresholds before evaluating room0 labels; every registered evaluation scene retained
